Congress Leaders March to PM Residence, Demand Resignation

Congress leaders Rahul Gandhi and Priyanka Gandhi Vadra led a march to the Prime Minister's residence. The leaders demanded the resignation of Prime Minister Narendra Modi. The march involved a protest and a sit-in demonstration. The coverage suggests this action may signal a turning point for the Modi government.
